scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:electron && vite build && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: node --test src/main.test.mjs src/renderer/src/*.test.mjs src/renderer/src/audio/*.test.mjs src/renderer/src/map/*.test.mjs src/renderer/src/compendium/*.test.mjs scripts/srd/*.test.mjs scripts/e2e/*.test.mjs && dotnet test src/backend.tests/DungeonDeputy.Api.Tests.csproj -c Release

scripts.package:smoke: npm run build:electron && vite build && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs
